name: Open-Typer 5.2.1
body:
**Change log:**
- Switched back to Qt 6.4 to fix maximized window state issues (WebAssembly builds still use 6.5) (#80).
- Fixed WebAssembly build crashing on launch (#75).
- Fixed result text in the pack editor updating only after editing the text 2 times (#77).

name: Open-Typer 5.2.0
body:
**Change log:**

- Updated Qt to 6.5 on Windows, macOS and Linux. (#44).
- Dropped Windows 7 and 8.
- Dropped Ubuntu 22.10 (PPA).
- Fixed keyboard input on WebAssembly.
- Added arm64 and armhf AppImages (#60).
- Fixed incorrect AppImage update information.
- Added pack editor (#61).

name: Open-Typer 5.2.0 Beta
body:
Beta pre-release for Open-Typer 5.2.0.
Full change log will be included with the 5.2.0 release.

name: Open-Typer 5.1.1
body:
**Change log:**

- Fixed scrolling with key navigation not working in native dialogs (#53, #55).
- Fixed table in the export dialog not displaying correctly (#56).
- Added Ukrainian translations (#58 - @CakesTwix).

name: Open-Typer 5.1.0
body:
**Change log:**

- Added support for nested dialogs (#36).
- Added automated grading (with configurable classes and results for specific months) (#27).
- Switched to modular source code structure (#41).
- Fixed update checks when they're disabled in settings.
- Added support for Ubuntu 23.04.
- Fixed next key not being highlighted on the keyboard in Qt 5.12 builds (#40).
- Removed the SK QWERTZ (ADK) lesson pack due to licensing issues.
- Removed addons.
- Switched to native dialogs on desktop (#43).
- Set the default font to "FreeMono" on Linux and "Courier New" on Windows and macOS.
- Added Ubuntu 23.04 support in PPA packages.

name: Open-Typer 5.0.3
body:
**Change log:**

- Fixed main window not maximizing on launch (#35).
- Fixed unchangeable font in appearance settings (#34).
- Fixed black bar below title bar issue on Windows (#38).
- Fixed window geometry issues on macOS.

name: Open-Typer 5.0.2
body:
**Change log:**

- Fixed window state not getting restored after locking user interface in the typing test dialog (#30).
- Fixed remaining window geometry issues (#29).
- Fixed random crashes during timed exercises.
- Fixed combo boxes randomly closing in settings (#33).
- Fixed redundant transitions in settings (#31).

name: Open-Typer 5.0.1
body:
**Change log:**

- Improved keyboard navigation and accessibility support (#11).
- Fixed rendering issues on some special (GNU/Linux) desktop environments (#25).
- Fixed empty backslash key on the on-screen keyboard (#18).
- Miscelaneous improvements (#24).
- Fixed detection of right shift and right control on the on-screen keyboard (#19, #28).

name: Open-Typer 5.0.0
body:
**Change log since v4.4.4:**

- New modern user interface (made with Qt Quick).
- Improved the layout of the tool bar.
- Moved exercise results to the main window.
- Moved exercise history to the main window.
- Improved dialogs such as the typing test or timed exercise dialog.
- New appearance settings.
- Added customizable accent color.
- Added addons (still in development, no addons are currently available).
- Added support for macOS.

**Unimplemented v4 features:**
- Settings lock (please open an issue if you think this feature is useful).
- Pack editor (will be added in v5.2.0).

**Change log since v5.0.0-rc:**
- Fixed issues with settings categories created by addons.
- Fixed main window geometry issues.
- Fixed paper not updating when the font is changed (#15).
- Fixed issues with the typing test dialog.

name: Open-Typer 5.0.0 Release candidate
body:
**Change log since 5.0.0 Beta:**

- Disabled high DPI scaling on Windows because it doesn't work correctly in Qt 5 (it'll be enabled later).
- Fixed addon installation on Windows.
- Fixed splash screen not closing after the main window opens.
- New splash screen.
- Improved performance on slower computers.
- Fixed menu bar in Qt 5.12 builds.
- Fixed theme issues in the export dialog.
- Implemented window position and geometry saving.

name: Open-Typer 5.0.0 Beta
body:
**Change log since 5.0.0 Alpha:**

- Fixed a crash when the application is closed.
- Added valid menus to the application menu bar.
- Added addon settings (there aren't any addons available yet).
- Fixed language settings not appearing in Qt 6 builds (#16).
- Fixed random crashes after finishing an exercise (#20).
- Fixed on screen keyboard not fitting in paper.
- Fixed broken layout of the on screen keyboard in Qt 5.12 and Qt 6 (#21, #22).
- Fixed broken mistakes in validated exercises caused by mistakes at the end of a line (#14).
- Fixed incorrect values in the export dialog (#17).
- Fixed double clicks not working in menu bar.
- Fixed width of some menu bar items.

name: Open-Typer 5.0.0 Alpha
body:
Alpha pre-release for Open-Typer 5.0.0.
Full change log will be included with the 5.0.0 release.

name: Open-Typer v4.4.4
body:
**Change log:**

- Increased line length in custom exercises (loaded from a file).
- This is the last v4 release.

name: Open-Typer v4.4.3
body:
**Change log:**

- Fixed snap crashing on Wayland.
- Improved detection of dead keys.
- Fixed incorrect selected theme in appearance options (introduced in v4.4.0)
- Fixed error 1638 in installer for Windows.

name: Open-Typer v4.4.2
body:
**Change log:**

- Switched back to Qt 5 on Windows (to support Windows 7 and 8).

name: Open-Typer v4.4.1
body:
**Change log:**

- Added Russian translation (thanks @Roker2, #4).

name: Open-Typer v4.4.0
body:
**Change log:**

- Switched to Qt 6 on Windows.
- Various bug fixes.
- Moved core parts of the application into a shared library.
- Removed network features (server and client) - will be moved to a separate addon.
- Added dark theme option to View menu.
- Remove new line with space option from settings (both space and enter/return can be used).
- Changed exercise time format from seconds to minutes and seconds in summary dialog.
- Made updates less disturbing by turning the update dialog to a top bar popup.
- Fixed text "repeating" in timed exercises.
- Added support for arm64, armhf and ppc64el architectures in Snap packages.
- Added accuracy to exercise summary dialog.

name: Open-Typer v4.3.4
body:
**Change log:**

- Added Ubuntu 22.10 support.
- Reduced initial setup window size.

name: Open-Typer v4.3.3
body:
**Change log:**

- Fixed enter/return key activating close button in settings.
- Added a confirmation dialog to user interface lock (when the user accidentally closes the window).

name: Open-Typer v4.3.2
body:
**Change log:**

- Dropped 32-bit support on Windows.
- Added vcredist installer to Windows installer (fixed missing vcruntime dll files).
- Disabled full screen mode on application start.
- Fixed inaccurate calculation of hits per minute.
- Added timed exercise countdown to input field.
- Disabled keyboard visibility saving when settings lock is enabled.
- Renamed "correct mistakes" feature to "character correction after mistake".
- Fixed translation of splash screen.

name: Open-Typer v4.3.1
body:
**Change log:**

- Fixed settings lock bugs on WebAssembly.
- Fixed translation bugs introduced in v4.3.0.
- Updated documentation URL.

name: Open-Typer v4.3.0
body:
**Change log:**

- Source code cleanup.
- Fixed a crash in connection options.
- Added settings lock (can be used to lock application settings using a password).

name: Open-Typer v4.2.0
body:
**Change log:**

- Added support for AppImage updates.
- Added Snap Store support.
- Added close button to options (#2).
- Added a way to change mistake count limits.
- Added a splash screen.
- Renamed customization options to appearance options.
- Added simple theme mode (light or dark theme).
- Removed system (native) theme.
- Added category icons to options.

Commands to install the Snap package:
`sudo snap install open-typer`

name: Open-Typer v4.1.0
body:
**Change log:**

- Text from error words now repeats every error word 5 times.
- Added AppImage support.
- Fixed student name in typing test wait dialog (in full mode).
- Disabled name editing in typing test wait dialog (in full mode).
- Fixed a crash occurring when an invalid language is set.
- Added a way to edit student names during typing tests.
- Added connection test after closing connection options.
- Fixed application name in some dialogs.
- Disabled Esc key in pack editor and typing test wait dialog.
- Added correct characters above every mistake to exercise result preview.
- Removed line length and include newlines settings.

name: Open-Typer v4.0.1
body:
**Change log:**

- Fixed mistakes at line end not wrapping the lines.
- Fixed switched characters in exercise validation (e. g. abcd -> acbd).
- Removed tab-based navigation from pack editor.
- Added human-readable pack names to class and student statistics.
- Fixed empty version and revision on Ubuntu.

name: Open-Typer v4.0.0
body:
**Change log:**

* Fixed memory leaks in language manager.
* Added light blue theme.
* Added an option to disable update checks on Windows.
* Moved Class Monitor server to main application.
* Open-Typer Class Monitor has been deprecated.
* Added an option to disable mistake correction (the exercise is validated after it ends).
* Added an option to hide exercise text.
* Fixed exercise line length resetting after reloading a custom exercise.
* Added validated text export.
* Added menu bar to main window.
* Fixed text resetting after opening options.
* Removed page title from printed custom exercises.
* Fixed mistakes at line end.
* Fixed scrolling of mistake markers.
* Fixed multiple mistakes in the same position.
* Added a second server mode without any accounts (static IP addresses required).
* Added typing test feature.
* Switched to websocket.
* Added window state saving.
* Fixed inaccurate time in timed exercises.
* Added mistakes (input text instead of the correct text) to exercise text preview.
* Fixed calculation of gross and net hits.
* Changed executable name to open-typer.
* Created a PPA for Ubuntu (currently supports 18.04, 20.04 and 22.04).
* Added support for i386, armhf and arm64 architectures (only in Ubuntu PPA).

PPA link: https://launchpad.net/~adazem009/+archive/ubuntu/open-typer
Commands to add the PPA and install Open-Typer in Ubuntu:
```
sudo add-apt-repository ppa:adazem009/open-typer
sudo apt update
sudo apt install open-typer
```

name: Open-Typer v3.5.0
body:
**Change log:**

- Fixed exercise text and input text position.
- Fixed long text affecting window size.
- Disabled text zoom using control + mouse wheel.
- Switched to Qt's color dialog.
- Implemented translations of Qt Base.
- Placed the on-screen keyboard above text.
- Fixed invalid number of hits per minute.
- Changed maximum custom exercise size to 8 KB.
- Fixed a crash while closing server connection.
- Added exercise text printing.

name: Open-Typer v3.4.0
body:
**Change log:**

- Improved dynamic language changes.
- Added number of net and gross hits per minute to summary window.
- Added text generated from error words.
- Added reversed text.
- Moved timed exercise and exercise history to top panel.
- Removed Ubuntu 20.04 packages (current packages can be used in 18.04 or newer releases).

name: Open-Typer v3.3.0
body:
**Change log:**

- Fixed incorrect configuration directory path on Windows.
- Fixed memory leaks.
- Added German (Germany) lesson packs.

name: Open-Typer v3.2.1
body:
**Change log:**

- Changed maximum font size from 20 to 24.
- Fixed remaining text moving to the bottom of the screen after using exercise preview.
- Fixed font matching bugs introduced in v3.2.0.
- Switched to a new theme engine, which is faster than the previous one.
- Added word exercises to Czech auto-generated packs.
